quests.title: Maid-in-Training

dialogue.t: I finally get to meet you, Honorary Knight.
I'm Noelle, a maid of the Knights of Favonius.

dialogue.sit: The Knights of Favonius have... maids?
Is this... "maid-knight" attire?

dialogue.t: Ah — apologies... I've yet to officially join the Knights.
As a maid, and in order to be worthy of this armor, I'm currently undergoing the Knights of Favonius Chivalric Training.

dialogue.sit: "Chivalric Training"?

dialogue.t: Yes... I haven't passed the selection trials yet, but I've been asking senior knights for advice on how to become a true Knight of Favonius.
...I asked Amber how to make a Baron Bunny, and Kaeya's been keeping me busy with various small tasks...
I even asked the Spark Knight to pass on her experiences, although... Master Jean grounded us shortly after...

dialogue.sit: You seem to be... working hard...

dialogue.t: Actually... I have always wanted to receive guidance from the Honorary Knight.
I—I was worried that it might be too... presumptuous to ask...
I've seen you on the streets of Mondstadt occasionally, but I've always been too busy to disturb you...
I just finished today's cleaning for the Knights and was about to start my training when I saw you!
I... If it's not too much trouble... could I ask you for some guidance on my Chivalric Training?

dialogue.sit: Of course, where do you want to start?

dialogue.t: So as a senior knight... this is your suggestion?
But... as a maid, I'm only authorized to deal with smaller tasks.
The Knights of Favonius is the strongest shield that Mondstadt has. How can I defend the people if I'm only ever dealing with minor matters!
That's why I've always wanted to become a real knight of Favonius, to have the power to help more people!

dialogue.sit: A maid is a respectable position too, I'd like to become one.

dialogue.t: Huh? Y—You're joking hehehe... right?

dialogue.sit: I'm constantly running errands.
No matter how small the tasks, they still need someone to take care of them. I do small tasks all the time.

dialogue.t: Really? Even the Honorary Knight?

dialogue.sit: I'm constantly running errands.

dialogue.t: ...I thought the Honorary Knight would only ever be busy with powerful enemies like Stormterror...

dialogue.sit: The strength to fight powerful enemies only comes with the experience gained during the completion of smaller tasks.
Besides, you don't exactly mind such tasks, right?

dialogue.t: Well... that is true...
Come to think of it, whenever I see you in Mondstadt, you do always seem to be in a hurry...
And the fact is... you're hurrying to help others...

dialogue.sit: Go back to Mondstadt and see if there are people who need help.
Think of every small task as a kind of training.

dialogue.t: Oh... Okay, back to Mondstadt it is! Time for today's training to officially begin!
I—I'd like to get your opinion on something, as a senior knight!
I've been keeping up with my maidly duties and knightly exercises.
But training progress has been a little slow...

dialogue.sit: Maidly duties?

dialogue.t: Uh... it's really all just cleaning and tidying...
Roughly every other day, I do a major clean-up for the Knights of Favonius.
Under the beds, the windowsills... nothing can be left out. The smallest corners are the most likely to gather dust.
There are also all kinds of smaller domestic tasks, like preparing Captain Kaeya's eye patch, and helping Ms. Lisa keep her bookshelves in order.

dialogue.sit: Knightly exercises?

dialogue.t: Y'know, just basic strength and endurance training...
100 push-ups, 100 sit-ups, 100 squats...
And running two laps around Mondstadt as a morning routine.
I'm actually incredibly busy every day. It's just that... I always feel like something's missing.
S—Strength...?
But, I think I'm pretty strong...
After he got drunk, I carried Mr. Bruce back to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters myself...
I also carried the library's new bookshelves over from Springvale...
Even Mr. Huffman said I'm strong.

dialogue.sit: Can you show me?

dialogue.t: Ah! Of course!
However, even though it's only training... I can't raise my sword against the Honorary Knight.
I've got it! Let's go to the training ground at the Knights of Favonius Headquarters. There should be some training dummies there.
Rest? But... *sigh* ...I've still got so much work to do.
Besides... I'm still not skilled enough. Any free time that I get should be spent training.
If I want to become a real knight soon, I have to continue to put in more effort than the others.

dialogue.sit: A true knight also needs sufficient rest.

dialogue.t: But... time is precious... if I rest...
I'll feel guilty...

dialogue.sit: Stopping for occasional rest is all part of ensuring that you can train to your maximum ability.
If you're too busy, you won't have time to reflect on your progress and goals.

dialogue.t: Ohh... I really hadn't thought about that...
Resting... for the sake of training...
Ohhhh... so that's why Ms. Lisa always has afternoon tea in the library... I get it now!

dialogue.sit: In Lisa's case, I'm afraid it's probably just resting for the sake of resting...

dialogue.t: Huh... Now that you... mention it...

dialogue.sit: Never mind. Speaking of tea, let's have some!
And speaking of tea, let's have some!

dialogue.t: Oh! O—Okay!
No, no, it's okay... I'll be fine with a bit of rest, don't worry about me...
Sorry! If you really don't want to be examined, I still need to take care of you!
...There, there, take your time, try and take a deep breath first...
*catches breath* ...And finally... I was saved...
Well my name's Noelle. Don't worry sir, everything's alright. I'll be protecting you from now on.
So... where are you from? I don't think we've met in Mondstadt before.
Thanks... I... I'm not from Mondstadt.
My name is Alois. I'm a traveling merchant.
I was on my way to Mondstadt to acquire some of the reputed local wines... so I could take them back to Liyue... Little did I know...
Uh... Little did I know I'd run into savage monsters on the way! I mean... savage! They were twice my height!
I was so scared I ran all the way here, until I just couldn't run anymore... Thank goodness I found you and this... uh... maid.
It's okay, Mr. Alois. We're not far from Mondstadt.
Although I'm just an ordinary maid, the small task of escorting a visitor to the city is certainly within my power.
Uh, escort me to Mondstadt? Perfect! Let's go...
But, wait a moment... as a traveling merchant, you must have luggage and some goods?
Don't worry. No matter the quantity, I'll carry them for you!
Luggage? Goods? Uhh...
Yes! I remember now. The savage monsters I encountered? That's when I lost them!

dialogue.sit: I can get them back for you.

dialogue.t: No, no... no need! These monsters are ferocious! Three times my height!
Oh, rest easy — {NICKNAME} is Mondstadt's Honorary Knight. No monster is too ferocious for {M#him}{F#her}.
H—Honorary Knight? Then you're a member of the Knights of Favonius?

dialogue.sit: Where did you see those monsters?

dialogue.t: I, uhh... I—I can't remember exactly. I was too busy running...
P—Probably near that crossing in front of us... b—but I can't be sure... *sigh* Never mind...

dialogue.sit: Back soon.

dialogue.t: Wait... w—wait a minute! My chest! Argh! A sudden pain in my chest! It must be all that running. Let's look for those things a little bit later...
Oh! Chest pain? ...Here, I've got you. Hold my arms and lie down slowly.
Now do your best to relax. I will examine you.
Uhh... p—perhaps I... maybe you...
I'm sorry, I must stay here to watch over our visitor, {NICKNAME}. It looks like you'll need to handle the monsters. Oh — and please be careful!
Back so soon... A true senior knight!
Did you see Mr. Alois's luggage on the way?

dialogue.sit: Not a trace.

dialogue.t: Uh, perhaps the monsters ate it?

dialogue.sit: Only saw a few monsters...

dialogue.t: So there were monsters...
Didn't I tell you! It's dangerous!
Oh, you're not hurt, are you, {NICKNAME}?

dialogue.sit: They were only a few slimes.
They weren't exactly twice your height.

dialogue.t: Uh... um... wh—what I meant was...
When they jumped, they were thrice — ahem — twice as tall as me!

dialogue.sit: Twice or thrice...?

dialogue.t: ...Wh—Why are you looking at me like that? Even if they were only slimes, I couldn't have fought them off!
*sigh* What can we do? If even the Honorary Knight can't find them...
Heh... I'm a just traveling merchant, you never know what's gonna happen out here...
Oh well, looks like Mondstadt was never meant to be, perhaps next time...
I'm very sorry... In these circumstances, I must ask you to register the quantity and nature of your lost property with the Knights of Favonius.
I know that the Knights will do their best to help you recover your goods!
Ah!?
No, no, no! I—I couldn't possibly trouble the Knights of Favonius. This matter... it really is beneath them.
On the contrary, it's the duty of the Knights to look after any visitors traveling to and from Mondstadt.
As a maid, I must do my best in receiving and escorting such visitors.
But then... perhaps there's something keeping you from going to the Knights?
Heh... No! Absolutely nothing!

dialogue.sit: Noelle, can we talk for a moment?

dialogue.t: Mm? Everything okay?

dialogue.sit: This fellow seems suspicious to me.

dialogue.t: Well... actually, I noticed that too.
But since we don't have any evidence of wrongdoing, he deserves the benefit of the doubt.
This gentleman was seeking help at the gates of Mondstadt, which makes him a guest of the city.
Therefore, I must carry out my maidly duties.

dialogue.sit: You have a point...

dialogue.t: Mm-hmm, thank you for understanding!
Hey... what are you discussing? So what's next?
Oh... Sorry to keep you waiting!
We've talked it over, and we've decided to escort you back to Mondstadt!
Your point of view on these matters has truly been eye-opening for me, I have a lot to learn!
...Just thinking about it makes me feel more motivated than ever!
Wow... Noelle's motivated alright!

quests.description: In accordance with your growing fame as the Honorary Knight, one of your junior Knights of Favonius would like to receive your guidance...

quests.title: The Art of Hospitality

dialogue.t: Aha, Honorary Knight and Noelle. Were you two out on a mission?
Wait, who is this person behind you?
I... My name is Alois, I'm a humble merchant.
Ah, Mondstadt welcomes you, strange yet respectable traveler.
Please state your identity and purpose. The Knights of Favonius are here to ensure your safety.
Uh... ahem... I came to Mondstadt to import wines back to Liyue...
I see, but are you not carrying any luggage or goods?
I also don't see your name among the wine merchants that Mondstadt regularly deals with...
I... It's my first time visiting Mondstadt, but I expect to come back often...
Hmm... In that case, please show me the relevant documents issued by Liyue's Ministry of Civil Affairs. I need to verify your identity.
Huh? What on earth is the Min— ...Oh! Right, right, I... put them in my luggage!
...Luggage?
Oh, our apologies... This gentleman was just attacked by a monster and lost both his luggage and his goods.
Could you allow him to calm down a bit before we register him with the Knights?
Hmm, according to Article 10 of the Knights of Favonius Handbook, caution should be exercised with regard to unfamiliar visitors.
But Article 2 of the Knights of Favonius Handbook also says that one must not offend our visitors, right?
Mmm, well... In this situation... umm...
...I—It seems the Knights of Favonius Handbook has a bit of an overlap...

dialogue.sit: I'll keep an eye on him. Nothing bad will happen.

dialogue.t: Well... if you are keeping watch, there shouldn't be a problem...
After all, this is our Honorary Knight, the one who defended Mondstadt from the claws of the frenzied Stormterror.
Storm... terror?

dialogue.sit: Many times your height, without jumping.
He's a little fellow, not worth worrying about.

dialogue.t: Haha... indeed... good one...

dialogue.sit: Leave it to Noelle. She can take care of the situation.

dialogue.t: Hmm... if Noelle is willing to vouch for him, then I can rest easy.

dialogue.sit: After all, she is the most reliable maid in all Mondstadt.

dialogue.t: I'm... just doing my job...
"Most reliable"? I've got a way to go, but I will try to live up to that!

dialogue.sit: I'll be there too.

dialogue.t: Well then, I'm counting on you two to take care of this gentleman while he's in Mondstadt.
Ah... Angel's Share. So this barrel must be full with Mondstadt's celebrated wine, right? If only it could be imitated...

dialogue.sit: "Imitated"?

dialogue.t: Oh, uh... imported! That's the word.
Sorry to keep you waiting. Drink up!
This is a Dandelion Wine-based cocktail — I asked the bartender to add Calla Lily because it has a calming effect.
I know you've been on the road for a long time and cold drinks would be bad for your stomach.
So I requested less ice. Hope it's to your liking.
Calming?
Is this what they give to all visitors in Mondstadt?

dialogue.sit: ...Noelle's way of showing hospitality.

dialogue.t: Hehe... because you know I'm interested in Mondstadt wines?

dialogue.sit: You're very interested, no?

dialogue.t: Y—Yes! Just interested, mind you.
On another note, that drink's made me realize just how empty my stomach is...
Oh, so you're hungry too!
...How terrible of me. If I'd realized, I would've saved some pancakes for you.

dialogue.sit: Not to worry. Let's go to the Good Hunter restaurant.

dialogue.t: Oh, good idea! That sounds like a good place!
On another note, that drink's made me realize just how empty my stomach is...
Oh, so you're hungry too!
...How terrible of me. If I'd realized, I would've saved some pancakes for you.

dialogue.sit: Not to worry. Let's go to the Good Hunter restaurant.

dialogue.t: Oh, good idea! That sounds like a good place!
Aha... o—okay then...
Would you like to rest awhile at Angel's Share? It's our signature tavern.
Mmmm... smells incredible! So it's true... If you really want to sell Mondstadt wines, you can't do without Mondstadt dishes...
Maybe recipes will be easier to obtain than the brewing process...

dialogue.sit: Brewing process?
Easier to obtain?

dialogue.t: Oh! Uhh, what I mean is... the Dandelion Wine brewing process is unique — difficult to imitate! That's why we merchants can buy with confidence!
Haha, where was I... Let's see, what's on the menu... Hmm, so many dishes... hard to decide...
Can I help?
Uh, sure... What do you suggest?
Hm... Well, do you prefer red meat or white?
I like 'em both.
The Steaks here are cuts of freshly shipped Springvale Boar. I'd recommend having it served medium to really bring out the natural sweetness of the meat.
Mm... oh! Sweet Madame is another specialty. Crispy skin and tender meat — goes perfectly with wine!
However, those dishes alone aren't very healthy from a nutritional standpoint.
I recommend a Mushroom Pizza and a Satisfying Salad too on the side.
If that sounds okay, I'll place the order for you. This meal is on me, to make up for my inattentiveness.
That's too generous of you...
Please, enjoy. After all, it's your first meal here as a new visitor, and your last. I wouldn't want to give you the cold shoulder.
Huh? *coughing* M—My last!? *choking*
...You give this meal to... all new visitors, right?

dialogue.sit: It's just Noelle's way of showing hospitality.

dialogue.t: Wait... Is it really my last meal?

dialogue.sit: Your last meal as a new visitor, of course. So enjoy!

dialogue.t: Ah, haha... so that's what it means... Well, then I better make the most of it...

dialogue.sit: Where are we going after the meal?
Noelle, do we have anything else on the itinerary?

dialogue.t: How about With Wind Comes Glory?
For our final stop, I want to leave Mr. Alois with something to commemorate his time here.
So... that's the final stop, yes...?
Wait... what are we commemorating?
Aha... o—okay then...
How about With Wind Comes Glory?
For our final stop, I want to leave Mr. Alois with something to commemorate his time here.
So... that's the final stop, yes...?
Wait... what are we commemorating?

dialogue.sit: Where are we going after the meal?
Noelle, do we have anything else on the itinerary?

dialogue.t: Oh, here's your order, Noelle.
Thanks, Marjorie.
Mr. Alois, please accept this souvenir.
Eh-he, thanks. I will treasure this wood carving forev— ...Eh?
Wait, what's on the... Is that... the insignia of the Knights of Favonius?
I, maid Noelle, on behalf of Mondstadt and the Knights of Favonius, officially welcome you!
Wait... Knights of Favonius? How can you be both a maid and a part of the Knights of Favonius?

dialogue.sit: She's a maid of the Knights of Favonius.
She's a future knight of Favonius.

dialogue.t: So, so this gift is also a...

dialogue.sit: It's just Noelle's way of showing hospitality.

dialogue.t: So it's... a warning!
...So, just a regular souvenir?
Oh, I'm afraid this is all I had time for...
However, I hope it leaves you with a lasting impression of your trip to Mondstadt.
Now then, if you wouldn't mind accompanying me to the Knights of Favonius, the registration process only requires—
Ah—! N—no need! I uhh... suddenly I remember where I lost my luggage!
Oh? Well then we should at least go and file a report with the Knights—
—Nope, not necessary! Now that the danger's past, I'll just head over and retrieve it!
Huh? But... what about the savage monsters...?
For your protection, I feel strongly that one of our knights should escort you there.
Or... perhaps it's a little too soon but...
...I'll escort you. Let's go!
Ugh...

dialogue.sit: No need.
Allow me.

dialogue.t: Oh? ...You want to escort him yourself, {NICKNAME}?
...That would certainly put my mind at rest...
In that case, I'll report the situation to Swan. Let's meet back at the gates of the city a little later.
Please take care of Mr. Alois.
I'm afraid this is all I had time for...
However, I hope it leaves you with a lasting impression of your trip to Mondstadt.
I... I really don't understand... why you went to all this trouble...
I don't have any goods or relevant documents... plus I don't exactly look like your everyday honest merchant.
Even if there were nothing to suggest otherwise... surely it would've been better to take me straight to the Knights for investigation...
...And yet you still went to all this effort... to prepare all this for me...
Didn't you wonder whether the savage monsters — the missing cargo... What if it were all lies?
Why would I think that? I'm just doing what a maid of Favonius should do.
Knights of Favonius Handbook Article 2: "Do not exhibit suspicion or hostility towards visitors, no matter how suspicious they may seem."
You are a visitor from far away. You should be welcomed by me and by Mondstadt.
Even if there really is only a slight possibility that everything you say is true...
Being attacked by savage monsters, losing goods and documents... Isn't it times like these that people need help the most?
And if I had failed to offer our hospitality on such an occasion, despite there being no evidence to back up your claims...
...That's not the way a maid of Favonius should behave!
I see... Well, thank you...
It's... time for me to leave Mondstadt.
Huh? Why the hurry...?
We haven't recovered your lost property yet...
No need. I've just remembered where I left them.
Somewhere far, far away...
I'll be sure to keep a better eye on them next time.
Perhaps when I'm a visitor worthy of your hospitality, I can return to Mondstadt.
Umm... I'm not sure I fully understand what you mean...
But if you think you can retrieve your lost property, that's great.

dialogue.sit: You two clearly aren't talking about the same thing...
But at least the problem seems to be solved.

dialogue.t: What a short trip...
But... thank you for your care and hospitality, I've learned a lot...
Goodbye, Mondstadt. Goodbye, maid of the Knights of Favonius!
Ah, okay then... goodbye!
Mondstadt and I, maid Noelle of the Knights of Favonius, will always welcome you when you return!
Hmm... After that drink, I'm beginning to realize just how hungry I am...
I wonder if there's any place where I might get something to eat...
*whimpers*

dialogue.sit: Okay, no further.

dialogue.t: ...So this is the end?

dialogue.sit: I can't see anyone around.

dialogue.t: Meaning this is a good spot!?

dialogue.sit: If you understand, then nothing needs to be said.
If you don't understand, it's pointless to explain.

dialogue.t: Archons above! Oh, honorable knight, please have mercy! Forgive me! I'll confess! I'll confess to everything!
I was planning to investigate Mondstadt's Dandelion Wine — to see if I could find a way to imitate it!
I didn't expect you to see through it right from the start! Please! I—I never actually did anything!
It's attempted fraud at worst, right? Tell me it isn't punishable by death!
Or... or is it because you have no intention to try me at all...?
Wh—Which explains why you didn't expose me in the city — you simply chose a location to finish me!
Spare me, noble kn— ...Wh—What...?
Go...? I can go? Really?

dialogue.sit: No more scheming against Mondstadt.

dialogue.t: Of... Of course! With you and the maid around, who would dare?

dialogue.sit: ...Change your ways, and you are welcome to visit Mondstadt again.

dialogue.t: Yes sir! I understand! Goodbye, most honorable Honorary Knight!
Ah, {NICKNAME}, you're back.
Eh? How come... Mr. Alois isn't with you?

dialogue.sit: He left.

dialogue.t: Left? Already? Left Mondstadt...?
...And I didn't even get around to arranging his accommodations, or introducing the wine merchants to him...
...I must have been... negligent in some way... Did I leave him with a bad impression of Mondstadt...?
Why else would he have left without a farewell...?
Oh, I... I couldn't even handle this smallest of tasks...

dialogue.sit: He had a sinister plot, so I drove him away.

dialogue.t: A plot? ...So he was scheming the whole time?
As expected, I'm still too naive...
And that's why we have the Honorary Knight to rely on, in times of trouble...

dialogue.sit: He had to get back, it had nothing to do with you.

dialogue.t: You're just... trying to make me feel better...
Thank you, but...
I must have done something wrong! Our visitor would never have left in such a hurry...
*sigh* How can I ever become a real knight of Favonius like this...?
Quick, let's go catch up with her!

quests.description: You and Noelle met a strange guest near Mondstadt named Alois. Alois claims to be a merchant who has lost his cargo due to a monster attack. Noelle decides to bring Alois to Mondstadt to help him find his lost goods...

quests.title: Noelle's Strength

dialogue.t: Hi, Noelle! Are you here for the training too?
Oh? Our Honorary Knight has come too.
Hi, Ellin! I was just asking the Honorary Knight for training advice.
They want to see my basic skills first...
Do you still have spare training dummies here?
Oh, Noelle's basic skills, huh...? Then the normal dummies won't do...
Doesn't matter how we set them up, there'll be nothing left by the time Noelle's done with them.

dialogue.sit: Nothing left...?

dialogue.t: It is Noelle after all! Let me think... How should I arrange them...?
Ah! I've got it. One moment!
This will work much better for Noelle!

dialogue.sit: Really? This won't be too difficult for her?

dialogue.t: Hmm... Could be a problem... There sure are a lot...

dialogue.sit: Right? Surely it's too much.

dialogue.t: It'll certainly require one heck of a clean-up.
Go, Noelle! You can do it!
Whew! Finally, clean-up over!

dialogue.sit: Such incredible strength...

dialogue.t: Y—You're... too kind! Praise from the Honorary Knight is high praise indeed...
But sadly I'm afraid that... my strength is the only thing I truly am confident in...
Every time I train and compete with the knights, I can't figure out how to use it.
Even though I swing my blade with greater force than my opponent, I always seem to lose in the final moments.
No matter how hard I train, I can never pass the selection trials.
Why? I just can't figure it out...

dialogue.sit: Is it because you lack real-world fighting experience?
Because... you still need more strength!

dialogue.t: Real-world fighting experience?

dialogue.sit: Noelle, you've always worked as a maid in Mondstadt, right?
Noelle, you rarely leave Mondstadt for training, right?

dialogue.t: I guess... that's true.
After all, if I were to leave the city, I wouldn't be there when people needed me...
But you're right, I haven't had much real-world fighting experience... Where can I get some?

dialogue.sit: You could start by training in the areas around Mondstadt.
Slimes are a good starting point.

dialogue.t: Areas around Mondstadt... Slimes... Leave them to me!
More... strength...?
But of course... Compared to the Honorary Knight, who defeated Stormterror, I don't have nearly enough strength...
Please teach me, Honorary Knight! How do you normally train?

dialogue.sit: I use my sword for mining all over Teyvat.

dialogue.t: Mining? You use your sword for... mining?
Then again... mining builds arm strength... and then there's the hiking between ore veins... perhaps even a monster or two to fight along the way...
So this is the Honorary Knight's training method, right? I must try it!

dialogue.sit: Prepare yourself, mining isn't as easy as you think.

dialogue.t: No problem! Leave it to me!
Why is Noelle... Is she planning to destroy them all in one go?

quests.description: Noelle, who aims to become a Knight of Favonius, has shared her troubles with you and hopes that you'll be able to help her with her chivalric training. To display the fruits of her daily training to her, Noelle takes you to the Knights' training ground...

quests.title: Live Practice

dialogue.t: Ugh... It was too far up in the air, I couldn't get to it...

dialogue.sit: If it were me just now, I would have gone to Amber or Lisa for help.
It is precisely because the power of a single knight is limited that the Knights of Favonius was formed. Don't you think?
Unity and teamwork allow each knight to better utilize their strengths.
Noelle, why don't you choose the final training target?
Choosing an appropriate enemy is also a part of your training...
Let's do it together.

dialogue.t: If only Amber or Miss Lisa were here...
No! I can't think like that. As a Knight, I must rely on my own strength...
Huh? But...
That makes sense... If only I'd fought together with you just now...
"The camaraderie and solidarity of its members form the backbone of the Knights of Favonius..."
So that's what Article 8 of the Knights of Favonius Handbook really means...
I never... looked at it that way before...
Me? ...You think I can choose a suitable target?
Really? Let me think...
...I should avoid enemies that I find difficult... and consider the power of teamwork... hmm...
Hmm... Ah! I've got it!
I heard from Master Jean that there was a hilichurl camp nearby, that often attacks traveling merchants.
Even though driving away hilichurls is usually something for the Knights...
Maybe this time... I can do it!
Great, you and me!
...Exhausting... It was too far up in the air, I couldn't get to it...
If only Amber or Miss Lisa were here...
No! I can't think like that. As a Knight, I must rely on my own strength...

dialogue.sit: If it were me just now, I would have gone to Amber or Lisa for help.

dialogue.t: Huh? But...

dialogue.sit: It is precisely because the power of a single knight is limited that the Knights of Favonius was formed. Don't you think?
Unity and teamwork allow each knight to better utilize their strengths.

dialogue.t: That makes sense... If only I'd fought together with you just now...
"The camaraderie and solidarity of its members form the backbone of the Knights of Favonius..."
So that's what Article 8 of the Knights of Favonius Handbook really means...
I never... looked at it that way before...

dialogue.sit: Noelle, why don't you choose the final training target?

dialogue.t: Me? ...You think I can choose a suitable target?

dialogue.sit: Choosing an appropriate enemy is also a part of your training...

dialogue.t: Really? Let me think...
...I should avoid enemies that I find difficult... and consider the power of teamwork... hmm...
Hmm... Ah! I've got it!
I heard from Master Jean that there was a hilichurl camp nearby, that often attacks traveling merchants.
Even though driving away hilichurls is usually something for the Knights...
Maybe this time... I can do it!

dialogue.sit: Let's do it together.

dialogue.t: Great, you and me!
Here we are! Let's start with Geo Slimes...
Th—Thank the Anemo Archon! Finally, I'm saved...
Ah... and thanks to Noelle and the Honorary Knight too...
If it hadn't been for you two, I can't imagine what would have happened.

dialogue.sit: Just glad you're okay.

dialogue.t: You guys are here to save me... right?
We were training nearby and happened to hear you calling my name. Luckily, we got here just in time.

dialogue.sit: We were quite far away...
Could you really recognize Noelle from that distance?

dialogue.t: Haha... I think I wanted to say "help," or "Barbatos protect me," or something to that effect...
I didn't even realize that I'd called out Noelle's name instead.
I guess in Mondstadt we're just so used to calling Noelle's name when we're in trouble.

dialogue.sit: Sounds like you're a little too dependent on her.

dialogue.t: Oh, it's fine! It's an honor to be able to help everyone.
Not to mention, I might not have registered Henning's cry if that weren't the case.
Still... good thing the hilichurls we encountered weren't too fierce. Thankfully, I was able to handle them.
Huh? Not too fierce? I was so scared I couldn't even move my legs.

dialogue.sit: Those weren't weak hilichurls.
You've gotten stronger.

dialogue.t: R—Really?
I just did what I usually do...

dialogue.sit: The intention was different.
This wasn't training... you were trying to protect someone.

dialogue.t: Ah, I guess so...
I did have my mind set on not letting Henning get hurt...
So if my intention is different, it can have a big effect on the outcome...

dialogue.sit: It's because protecting others is the source of your strength.

dialogue.t: You know, I think you're right!
Whenever Noelle is helping us out, she's usually more powerful than in training!

dialogue.sit: This is no reason for you to rely on her though.
In the future, don't leave everything to Noelle.

dialogue.t: Ahaha... Absolutely. No more of that.
...In any case, I'm extremely grateful to you both.
N—No problem, merely fulfilling my duties as a maid of Favonius!
Maid Noelle of the Knights of Favonius, at your service!

quests.description: Noelle has great strength but is never able to use it in real fights. You arrange some training to help her gain more practical combat experience...

quests.title: Strength Training

dialogue.t: Whoa... what a rockfall!
Ah... Ms. Belinda, is that you?
Is that Noelle? And the Honorary Knight, too?
A—Are you hurt?
Don't worry, I'm fine. I'd already passed through the rockfall zone on my patrol.
There's actually been a lot of rockfalls here lately... but it's the first time I've seen one of such magnitude during my patrols.
Did you guys see anything suspicious?

dialogue.sit: No.
Not at all.

dialogue.t: Hmm... The more I think about it, surely nobody could be responsible for something of this scale.
*sigh* Regardless, this will be difficult to clear...
There are ore veins rich in reserves here, all blocked behind the boulders...
Did you say, ore veins?

dialogue.sit: ...Ore veins?

dialogue.t: Yeah, I'll need to enlist some folks to clear this up quickly.
Otherwise, how will we ever get to the ore...
Hmm, the ore...

dialogue.sit: ...Ore?

dialogue.t: So once the boulders are out the way, mining can start up again?
Precisely, but a rockfall of this magnitude needs reporting to the Knights first—
Leave it to me! I think I can handle this!
Uh... huh?
This is it, let's clear up these outcrops!
Phew...
...Job done!

dialogue.sit: So the training targets were just mining outcrops...
Noelle really wasn't kidding about her strength...

dialogue.t: Are you guys okay? Noelle... you're okay, right?
Hmm? Oh, I'm okay! Though I must say...
...My shoulders are sorer than usual, compared to my normal cleaning duties that is.

dialogue.sit: Is cleaning up for the Knights that intense...?

dialogue.t: I—I'm ashamed to admit that... even though we try and get Noelle to take it easy...
...Every time we get back from somewhere, she's somehow single-handedly managed to clean the entire Knights of Favonius Headquarters.
A—All in a day's work for a maid of Favonius...
If I want to become a knight, I need to take all aspects of training seriously.
So, Honorary Knight... the ore mining training... H—How did I do?

dialogue.sit: Your strength blew me away!
You did much better than I expected. To be honest, at first I...

dialogue.t: R—Really? So under your personal guidance I completed the training? What an honor!
...Next time, let's mine together!
This is a rockfall-prone area. You shouldn't be stopping here without good reason.
Huh? Wait... Is that a Knight of Favonius up ahead? Let's find out what's going on!

quests.description: Noelle has great strength, but the path to greater strength is never-ending. Your suggestion to help her bring out yet more power is... mining.

quests.title: Fleeting Leisure

dialogue.section: Go to Good Hunter and take a little break

dialogue.t: Noelle—!
B—Bea...?
What happened? Is there something I can help you with?
Quinn! He's ignoring me again...
Take your time, no rush. I'm here to help.
I... *whimpers* ...noticed Quinn was in a bad mood, so I wanted to call him over for a chat...
And... a date, I guess.
Oh? A d—date...
So it's... that kind of a problem?
Yes! I've been over to him several times today already...
But no matter how I try to make conversation, he just focuses on his stall and ignores me completely!
Noelle, everyone in Mondstadt thinks you're really cute...
You must be really popular, right? Can you help me out...?
Ah! Of... of course! It's a maid's responsibility to help the residents of Mondstadt!
It's just... I... I don't have any experience in this area...
*sigh* ...Even Noelle can't help me...?
Please, don't worry! I... Oh! We also have the Honorary Knight here!
Honorary Knight... can you help Bea?

dialogue.sit: Didn't we say we were going to take a break?

dialogue.t: I—I'm so sorry!
But as a maid of Favonius, I can't stand idly by when people are in need.
I'll do some serious planning and make sure we can have a day off together another time!

dialogue.sit: So even a break requires serious planning...

dialogue.t: Indeed. But today... can you help Bea come up with a solution?

dialogue.sit: Well, if you insist...
I'll certainly do my best...

dialogue.t: Oh! Thank you!

dialogue.sit: Let's analyze the situation first...

dialogue.t: Okay! Bea said that Quinn always seems busy and ignores everything she says...
But... I know that she's often looking for small talk with Quinn...

dialogue.sit: Maybe the frequent small talk...
...So Quinn feels that Bea has nothing important to say to him...

dialogue.t: That's... a possibility!
In other words... we just need to make Quinn realize that this time is different.
For example... by sending him a little gift. Even Quinn would notice the difference a gift would bring!
But what kind of gift...?

dialogue.sit: It shouldn't matter, it's the thought that counts.

dialogue.t: Are you sure? I still feel the choice of gift matters... no matter what kind of relationship two people share.
But, I don't have any experience in this area. I'm sure you're right.
Then... if the gift doesn't matter, the choices are limitless... I can't decide...
Do you have any ideas?

dialogue.sit: Sending a Mondstadt Grilled Fish should be fine.

dialogue.t: Huh... Will this really get his attention?
That's what I think!
Everyone has their preferences, so it's important to choose the right gift if you want to get through to them.
If it were me, I'd want roses.
As for you, Honorary Knight... hmm...
I bet you like handmade things...

dialogue.sit: Roses and handmade things both sound nice.
But let's think about what Quinn might like...

dialogue.t: Oh, yes! I... I just wanted to try thinking from a different perspective...
Hmm... Quinn... What kind of gift would he like...?
If I remember correctly, isn't Quinn one of the Four Drunkards of Mondstadt...?
Perhaps something wine-related would do, but what...?
Hmm, simply thinking about it isn't really helping...
Let's go to Marjorie's store and see what's available.

dialogue.section: Go to Good Hunter and take a little break

dialogue.t: Are there any particular snacks you like? I can get started with—

quests.description: Noelle, who aims to become a Knight of Favonius, has shared her troubles with you and hopes that you'll be able to help her with her chivalric training. To get the workaholic Noelle some rest, you suggest that the two of you have some tea and let loose a little...

quests.title: Gift and Intent

dialogue.section: Make a serving of Mondstadt Grilled Fish

dialogue.t: I hope Quinn understands Bea's intentions...
And I hope we were a help this time...

dialogue.sit: But now's not the best time to disturb them...
Now then, let's take that break...

dialogue.t: Mm... apologies, by the way. I said we would take a break and ended up bothering you.
Oh! If you're peckish, just let me know. I can whip something up for you right away!

dialogue.sit: No whipping anything up...
You're taking a break, remember?

dialogue.t: Argh, sorry. Old habits die hard...

dialogue.section: Make a serving of Mondstadt Grilled Fish

dialogue.t: How am I ever going to get Quinn to listen to me...?

dialogue.section: Give a serving of Mondstadt Grilled Fish to Bea

dialogue.t: Ugh...
Bea?
Oh... hi Noelle...
So... Ahem! Did you get a d—date with Quinn?
*sigh* I barely want to talk about it...
I hadn't even given him the Mondstadt Grilled Fish when he muttered something about not having an appetite and not wanting to eat.
I can't force him to eat, can I...?
Looks like I'll just have to try to ask him out some other time.
I... I must apologize.
Next time, I'll help you find a much better gift!
No need... It should be me apologizing. I was worried and dumped everything on you.
It's obvious, thinking about it now... Noelle can't be good at everything...
Oh...
It's okay. This isn't your fault, I don't blame you. I... I have to get going.
Please... take care...

dialogue.sit: ...Noelle...
...Everything okay?

dialogue.t: I'm... I'm fine...
It's just... I feel bad that I couldn't help Bea...

dialogue.sit: It's impossible to be an expert on everything, you know...

dialogue.t: You're not wrong... but if I give up so easily, then the next time someone needs help, I'll mess up again...
I may not know much about this sort of thing, but at the very least I should try to learn something about it...
I... I'm going to the Knights of Favonius library! There must be some guidance there on the subject of love!
The next time I encounter a situation like this, I'll be able to help...

dialogue.section: Give a serving of Mondstadt Grilled Fish to Bea

dialogue.t: What's... what's this? Not an attractive sight...
Smells a little strange, too... Surely this can't be what you want me give to Quinn?

dialogue.sit: O—Of course not...

dialogue.t: *sigh* I'll keep waiting for you here then.

dialogue.section: Give a serving of Mondstadt Grilled Fish to Bea

dialogue.t: "...since you've already noticed, I guess I can let you lend a hand."
...Ah, so that's how it works. When you meet the person who inspires your affections, you have to find a way to do things together with them...
Hmm. "...even if not old enough to drink, one should still learn to discuss the different qualities of wine..."
...I see, so you need to know how to make yourself interesting, to draw people's attention...

dialogue.sit: What are you reading?

dialogue.t: Ah! S—Sorry! I didn't see you there! I was deep in concentration...
I borrowed every book on love from the library that I could find.
When I've finished reading them, I'll finally be able to give decisive recommendations for next time! ...Even if it is me.

dialogue.sit: ...So, what books do we have here?

dialogue.t: Well, let's see... For example, "Vera's Melancholy," "Heart of Clear Springs"...
...All of them contain detailed records of the experience of love! As a maid, my experience leaves a lot to be desired, so I found the quickest way was to take examples from the classics!
There's also "A Guide to Tavern Chat," and "Shortcuts to Love"...
...These are much more practical in nature! And of course, there are even books that focus on theories of love!
And there's this one, this book's about... Mmm... hmm... hmm?

dialogue.sit: About what?
Can I take a look?

dialogue.t: N—No! ...Nothing! This book... it's too early to read this book...
L—Let's look at another one... You have to learn the basics first, after all...
Uh, so this book is about... huh? S—Same as that one...? Guess this must be a pretty... common topic...
*sigh* Looks like I... still have a lot to learn...

dialogue.section: Give a serving of Mondstadt Grilled Fish to Bea

dialogue.t: Uh... Mondstadt Grilled Fish... for Quinn?
I have often said that I would bring him lunch... Would this really work? Hmm...
Well, since it's Noelle's recommendation, I'll give it a try!

dialogue.section: Give a serving of Mondstadt Grilled Fish to Bea

dialogue.t: Fruit, fresh fruit... want some fruit?

dialogue.sit: Bea's gift...? Uhh...

dialogue.t: Oh... she said something about giving me something to eat... but I'm really not hungry right now...
Besides, she's constantly talking about bringing me lunch, so I didn't think anything of it this time...
Whew! All these b—books have got my heart racing...
I think I should take a break and do something else... to distract myself...
Then again, perhaps I should finish this one first. Just the one, right?
"Make time to be together alone," "Give {F#her}{M#him} a cake you made yourself"...
Words of counsel and wisdom are penned here in a lovely hand that unfortunately grew shaky towards the tail end.
Some of the text has been arbitrarily struck out, seemingly a result of the owner's emotions suddenly running high.
You know... I—I'm still a little worried about how Bea is doing...

quests.description: Noelle has, as is her wont, extended a helping hand to Bea, who is facing a bit of a romantic quandary. After some discussion, you decide to use a gift to help Bea get her feelings across...

quests.title: Gift and Intent

dialogue.t: Welcome to With Wind Comes Glory! Well, if it isn't Noelle and the Honorary Knight!
And what wind brought the two of you together? I barely ever see Noelle in someone else's company.

dialogue.sit: Barely ever?

dialogue.t: Well, when Noelle's working, she practically always takes care of things by herself.
And once she's finished with A, it's straight off to take care of B. Seems she hardly has time to catch her breath.
Say, Noelle... you're not a child anymore, you know?
If you don't take time out for yourself, you may come to regret it in future...
I, um... decided to take a break today...
But something came up...
Oh? So it's a day off... with the Honorary Knight?
Ooooh! How wonderful! That's something to celebrate!
You must be here to pick out a gift for the Honorary Knight? Choose anything you like. We have a lot that might tickle your fancy!

dialogue.sit: Actually, we're here to help someone else choose a gift.

dialogue.t: Aww, so shy! No use denying it though.

dialogue.sit: Actually, I'm here to buy a gift for Noelle.

dialogue.t: Oh! Well, it doesn't matter who's sending what to who... You can't get without giving!

dialogue.sit: Even without gifts, today is still a day to be celebrated.

dialogue.t: Wow! So this must be... an anniversary? How many years? Come on, give me the details...
Stop teasing!
Me and the Honorary Knight don't have that kind of relationship...
Hehehe... not yet!

dialogue.sit: Seems you have a knack for this kind of thing, Marjorie...

dialogue.t: Eh, I guess... After all, Noelle here is the type that needs a push every now and again.
But looks like she's still in the dark when it comes to these things.
I... I just feel... I shouldn't let such things distract me from my Chivalric Training!
Yes... there are too many important things to take care of...
Okay, okay, no more teasing. So, what is the reason for this visit?

dialogue.sit: It's like this...

dialogue.t: So... you're choosing a gift for Bea to give to Quinn...
In that case, I have a couple of fun new things in stock: a Frostening Bottle and a Squirrel Wood Carving.
The Frostening Bottle is very useful to keep alcohol cold and fresh for a long time.
As for the Squirrel Wood Carving... Well, it's a nice ornament, and it would look great at Quinn's stall.
So, bottle or ornament... which will it be?
A Frostening Bottle... a fitting gift for one of the Four Drunkards.
(They remembered what I said... Aww...)
So, Frostening Bottle it is? Alrighty, let me wrap it up for you.
Hmm... I'm a little worried that Quinn might just throw a wood carving in a drawer and forget about it...
To be on the safe side, how about we give him the Frostening Bottle?
As one of the Four Drunkards, he's sure to love it!
So, Frostening Bottle it is? Alrighty, let me wrap it up for you.
*sigh* How am I ever going to get Quinn to listen to me...?

dialogue.section: Give the Handpicked Gift to Bea

dialogue.t: Hmm? Give the Frostening Bottle to Quinn?
It does look like something that he'd be interested in.
Wait, wait... maybe... I can use the gift as bait... I could say that if he wants to get the gift then he'll have to come on a date with me first...
Thank you both so much! With this gift, there's no way Quinn will be able to refuse me!
Uh-huh... Is that how gifts work?
Well, as long as it helps!
Ah! Oh no!
What's wrong?
The gift? Is there something wrong with the gift?
No, no, it's not the gift...
I've been so focused on convincing Quinn, I haven't even thought about where our date's gonna be!

dialogue.sit: No... really?

dialogue.t: I've never gotten to that stage!
Noelle... could you help me...?
*sigh* A date should be properly planned, so I'll wait. No need to rush!
Just... leave it to me.

dialogue.section: Give the Handpicked Gift to Bea

dialogue.t: A date... Hmm, we'll need a place with pleasant scenery and a quiet atmosphere...
Let's look around. If we see anywhere good, let's take a picture and let Bea have the final say.
Let's head to Starsnatch Cliff next!
Oh! Let's go to Windrise!
Oh, you guys are back. What romantic locations did you find?

dialogue.sit: Starsnatch Cliff...

dialogue.t: Wait... aren't there people here already?
I don't want other people ruining the atmosphere while we're on the date...
Let's look at another place...
How... how about Windrise?

dialogue.sit: Cape Oath...

dialogue.t: Cape Oath... as in maybe taking a relationship oath? Sounds great!
You can see the sea from there, right? I love the sea.
Well, what do you think about Windrise?

dialogue.sit: Windrise...

dialogue.t: Yeah! What about Windrise?
May your love be as free as a dandelion...
Windrise? Hmm, that's a great location... but isn't it a bit cliché?
Huh? C—Cliché?
Well, old folks are always going on about something symbolic about that place... Besides, we've been there so many times when we were young.
It just feels like there's nothing special or new about it...
Oh... okay...
Hmm... I'm going with Cape Oath! Thanks so much. I'm off to find Quinn.
Ahhhh, Quinn... I wonder what kind of oath he'll make to me...
Uhh...
Is Windrise... no longer popular...?
But... the book said that it was the most popular place in Mondstadt...

dialogue.sit: When was the book written?

dialogue.t: Uh... I'm not sure, I found it while cleaning a corner of the library...
It was the story of Windrise and Lady Vennessa...
I thought folks in Mondstadt would still like to go there...

dialogue.sit: Don't worry about it. I like it.
Would you like to go there with me?

dialogue.t: Huh? You want to go to Windrise?

dialogue.sit: Think of it as our last break of the day.

dialogue.t: O—Okay! Follow me!
Okay, now that the gift is wrapped...
Let's hurry back and give it to Bea!

dialogue.section: Take a picture of the view of Falcon Coast from Cape Oath

dialogue.t: *sigh* The air here really refreshes you in an instant.
Forget about training and work, just breathe and feel the wind... Nothing else...

dialogue.sit: You can come here whenever you like, you know.

dialogue.t: Ha, that's true.
But training and work are still the things I need to focus on.
If I didn't take them seriously, I wouldn't be a reliable maid.

dialogue.sit: Isn't that tiring?

dialogue.t: Yes, to some degree. But, Lady Vennessa... and Master Jean... they worked much harder than me.

dialogue.sit: So this is the responsibility that you put on yourself?

dialogue.t: Put it this way, Lady Vennessa... and Master Jean... the responsibilities they carry — that they carried — those are the heaviest.
I know I have a lot to live up to. That's why I want to become a real knight of Favonius — to help more people.

dialogue.sit: You already possess the greatest qualities of a knight.
Helping others is the greatest quality of a knight.

dialogue.t: R—Really...? Thank you.
If you weren't here today, I wouldn't have been able to help Bea.
It's just a small token of appreciation, but I hope you'll accept it.
Roses are my favorite flower. This is a paper one that I folded by hand.

dialogue.sit: ...Do you know the meaning of a rose?

dialogue.t: Of course! In Mondstadt, roses represent the saying, "As wine bottles are corked, so too my lips are sealed."
I have seen and learned a lot during our time together.
It will become a wonderful memory — one that I will savor again and again...
I want it to remain in my heart and become a secret between the two of us.
*sigh* ...Wait! Do you mean that... roses have some meaning that I don't know about?

dialogue.sit: Uh... never mind.

dialogue.t: Oh... I'll need to go back to the library and find out...
Still, whatever a rose means...
I hope that this one can stay by your side in all your future adventures!
Before I'm able to fight alongside you, Honorary Knight...

dialogue.section: Take a picture of the view of Falcon Coast from Cape Oath

dialogue.t: Oh? You're back! Find any romantic locations?

dialogue.sit: Not yet...

dialogue.t: Oh... then please keep looking! This is really important to me.
...Quinn! Look! That's Falcon Coast — right there!
Wow, you really can see it... I've always thought it was far away... I had no idea how close it was.
Perhaps... there are other things around you that seem far away, but are actually very close...
You're right... So many potential customers out there...

quests.description: Noelle has, as is her wont, extended a helping hand to Bea, who is facing a bit of a romantic quandary. After some discussion, you decide to use a gift to help Bea get her feelings across...
